protocol.solver: HiGHS 1.13.1 native interface, single thread, same P2 matrices
protocol.distance_scan_inputs: first 3 U and O inputs at n=80
protocol.description: Frozen before formal execution; callbacks preserve MIP incumbents, analytical count bound remains valid independently of numeric solver output. Main historical inputs are reused unchanged; no witness is given to any algorithm. Supplemental shared LP setup and postprocessing are reported separately, not counted as independent inputs.
protocol.main_algorithm_seed: input seed + 70000, identical for G and LS
protocol.cpu_policy: Each single-thread run is bound to one of cores 0,1,2; all scales use the same three-worker scheduler.
